terms.comment: Classical sea-nymphs are the Nērēides, daughters of Nereus (Lewis & Short s.v. Nēreus); we have found no classical name for the half-fish mermaid of later tales. Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

terms.gloss: a Nereid, a sea-nymph of Greek myth

sources: Lewis & Short: nympha · Lewis & Short: nereus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 345.
